This petition is filed by the Petitioner against Respondent No.1 & 2 under Sec.166 of M.V.Act 1989 for the relief of compensation.
SCCH5 2

. The brief facts of the case is as under; That on 06.01.2019 at about 8.55 p.m. he had been riding a Star City motor cycle bearing Reg.No.KA50EC 0215 infront of Zed Earth, Bengaluru - Doddaballapura Road, Yelahanka Taluk, Bengaluru District, a Maxi Cab bearing Reg.No.KA02 AE1679 came from backside of the motor cycle in rash and negligent manner with excessive speed,
suddenly came infront of his motor cycle, due to which he could not control the motor cycle and dashed on backside of the Maxi Cab and fell down along with the motor cycle, sustained severe traumatic brain injury with diffuse brain edema and left acute SDH with midline shift, right parasymphysis, fracture of mandible septicemia and became unconscious.

Immediately after the accident, he was taken to Navachethana Hospital Bengaluru, wherein he took SCCH5 treatment as indoor patient, for which he has spent more than Rs.10,00,000/ towards medial and other expenses.

3. At the time of the accident he was aged about 26 years, hale and healthy, working as driver in Professional and Skill Training and Consultancy Pvt. Ltd., thereby earning more than Rs.40,000/
p.m., due to this accident, he is bed ridden and he is being looked after by an attendant by paying Rs.500/ per day and he is not in a position to do his work.

sentences.text: Out of this accident crime No.1/2019 is registered before the Rajanukunte Police against driver of the said Maxi Cab.
R1 is the owner, R2 is insurer of the said offending vehicle, they are jointly and severally liable to pay compensation.
Hence, prays to allow the petition and grant compensation of Rs.50,00,000/ with interest at the rate of 12% p.a. SCCH5 4.
On service of notice, R1/owner has appeared and filed written statement denying case of the petitioner.
He is ownercumdriver of the Force Maxi Cab bearing Reg.No.KA02AE1679 and he had valid and effective driving license as on the date of accident.
Further he has insured the said vehicle with R2 and the said policy was in force as on the date of accident.
Accordingly prays to dismiss the petition.

On going through the rival pleadings of the parties, my learned predecessor has framed the following:
::ISSUES::
1. Whether Petitioner proves that, on 06.01.2019 at about 8.55 p.m. while he was proceeding on his Star City SCCH5 motor cycle bearing Reg.No.KA50EC 0215 when he reached infront of Zed Earth, BengaluruDoddaballapura Road, Yelahanka Taluk, Bengaluru District, at that time, a driver of the Force Maxi Cab bearing Reg.No.KA02 AE1679 came from back side in a rash and negligent manner, he suddenly came infront of the motor cycle due to which the petitioner could not control the motor cycle and dashed to back side of the Force Maxi Cab, as a result of which, petitioner fell down and he sustained grievous injury, as mentioned in claim petition?
2.
Whether the Petitioner is entitled for compensation as prayed in the petition?

If so from which respondent?
3.
What order
or award?

::ADDITIONAL ISSUE::
1. Whether the respondent No.2 proves that, he has not issued policy bearing SCCH 5 No.0725813117P115748019 to the Force Maxi Cab bearing Reg.No. KA02 AE 1679 involved in the alleged accident and issed the policy No.0725813117P115748019 to the vehicle bearing Reg.No.AP02Y0667 as contended at para No.4a of the statement of objections?

19. Issue No.2 and Additional Issue No.1:
As these two issues are interrelated to each other, there are taken together for common discussion.

As per the SCCH5 evidence of the petitioner, he had sustained severe traumatic brain injury with diffuse brain edema and left acute SDH with midline shift, right parasymphysis fracture of mandible septicemia, for which he underwent 1) left FTP decompressive craniectomy and acute SDH evacuation 2) Bone flap replacement abdomen under GA on 07.01.2019.

further he underwent surgery in the form of ORIF for right mandible fracture, inview of prolonged ventilation, ENT consultation was sought, surgical tracheotomy done under GA on 14.01.2019, on 19.01.2019 secondary suturing done to scalp surgical wound leak, on 29.01.2019 under all aseptic precautins tracheotomy tube decannulation done and wound closed and dressing applied.
Thereafter treatment was continued with support of physiotherapy, then discharged on 14.02.2019.

Again he undergone operation SCCH5 i.e., left FTP auto cranioplasty+bone flap removal abdomen under GA on 22.03.2019, on 11.10.2019 he undergone operation for excision of osteomyelitis bone flap under GA.
